theorems.name: Submission.dorag_th_tilt_energy_inequality
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ) (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P) (ζ : Euclid P → ℝ), W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → AEStronglyMeasurable H R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ W → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → Module.finrank ℝ S = n → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ W → ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (ζ x ^ 2 * ∑ i : Fin P, ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal 16 * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (‖fderiv ℝ ζ x‖ ^ 2 * ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure + ENNReal.ofReal 4 * ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (κ * ζ x ^ 2 * ‖(x - ξ) - S.starProjection (x - ξ)‖) ∂R.measure
